---
title: "Data: online platforms"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("data/catalogue/helpers.R")
downloads <- utils::read.csv("data/catalogue/downloads.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ids <- c("snap-wiki-talk-temporal", "snap-wiki-rfa", "snap-sx-mathoverflow", "snap-sx-askubuntu", "snap-sx-superuser", "nr-fb-forum", "snap-bitcoin-otc", "snap-bitcoin-alpha", "snap-act-mooc", "gharchive-sample")
```

Interactions recorded by online platforms: Wikipedia talk pages and adminship votes, question-and-answer sites, a forum, trust ratings between Bitcoin traders, actions in a course, and GitHub activity. They are large (up to millions of events), with heavy-tailed activity and strong concentration on a few actors, and several are bipartite (users acting on items).

The [data catalogue](data-catalogue.html) lists every dataset with its licence. Figures
and numbers on this page are aggregates computed from the files as published;
each section links the source and the code that reads it.

```{r summary-table}
summary_table(ids)
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
render_group(ids)
```
